name: memory-mcp
label: Memory
description: Persistent agent memory. The memory tool saves, updates and deletes markdown topic files in a shared agent scope and a private user scope. What it saves loads into the prompt by itself.

skills.description: Worked examples for the memory tool: create a topic, revise a fact in place, append, delete, read one section of a long topic, share a personal topic with the agent, and the exact command shapes. Use when unsure how to write or edit a memory topic.
